steps.en: The officer opens the suspended notice from the work item
steps.id: Officer membuka notice yang di-suspend dari work item
steps.why_en: The notice can be searched by number, but there is no work item to open it from.
steps.why_id: Notice bisa dicari lewat nomor, tetapi tidak ada work item untuk membukanya.

steps.en: The officer enters the amount paid and receipt details
steps.id: Officer memasukkan jumlah bayar dan detail receipt
steps.why_en: Amount and date can be typed, but the original receipt cannot be entered or linked.
steps.why_id: Jumlah dan tanggal bisa diketik, tetapi receipt asli tidak bisa diisi atau ditautkan.

steps.en: The notice is updated as paid for the amount paid
steps.id: Notice di-update sebagai lunas sesuai jumlah bayar
steps.why_en: Fully paid only when the amount covers the current amount payable; less becomes a partial payment.
steps.why_id: Lunas hanya jika jumlahnya menutup jumlah yang harus dibayar; kurang dicatat sebagai bayar sebagian.

steps.en: No manual reduction is needed before the payment is updated
steps.id: Tidak perlu pengurangan manual sebelum pembayaran di-update
steps.why_en: Nothing adjusts the amount payable; the officer still has to reduce it by hand.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang menyesuaikan jumlah yang harus dibayar; officer tetap harus mengurangi manual.

steps.en: The notice ends as paid and the mismatch suspension is released
steps.id: Notice berakhir sebagai lunas dan suspension selisih dilepas
steps.why_en: The notice becomes paid, but the old mismatch suspension is not closed by this step.
steps.why_id: Notice jadi lunas, tetapi suspension selisih yang lama tidak ditutup oleh langkah ini.
